title: Kissed with sweetness Mediterranean fish Pilaf
description: A sweet and pillowy one-pot Mediterranean dish featuring figs, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the cod fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until lightly browned.
Add the crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Add the chopped fresh parsley and cook for another minute.
To serve, place the fish on a plate and spoon some of the pilaf mixture alongside.
Garnish with additional parsley and serve immediately.
If using dried figs, rehydrate them by soaking in hot water for a few minutes before adding to the dish.
To make the pilaf more sweet, drizzle with a little honey or sugar to taste.
